record.paper_title: Open Problems and Conjectures on Rational Systems in Three Dimensions
record.original_question: Consider the third-order rational difference equation z_{n+1} = (gamma + alpha z_{n-1} + delta z_n z_{n-1} + alpha_1 beta z_{n-1} z_{n-2})/(C + A z_{n-1} + D z_n z_{n-1} + alpha_1 B z_{n-1} z_{n-2}), for n = 0, 1, ..., with nonnegative parameters and nonnegative initial conditions such that all denominators are positive. For each of the 225 special cases included in this equation, determine the boundedness character, the periodic behavior, and the global stability character of its equilibrium points.

artifact.status_search_result: The 225 special cases of third-order rational difference equations are the subject of the Camouzis–Ladas monograph and associated open-problem collections. Published results address many individual cases (e.g., the 135 with only bounded solutions and seven known periodic trichotomies), but the comprehensive determination of boundedness, periodicity, and global stability for all 225 cases remains an ongoing research program with many cases still listed as open problems and conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Dynamics of Third-Order Rational Difference Equations with Open Problems and Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: The main part of the book presents the known results of each of the 225 special cases of third order rational difference equations... numerous thought-provoking open problems and conjectures on the boundedness character, global stability, and periodic behavior of solutions.
status_evidence.claim: The 225 special cases of third-order rational difference equations are an active framework with many open problems and conjectures regarding boundedness, periodicity, and global stability.

status_evidence.title: Stability and periodic character of a rational third order difference equation
